messages:
Sam (PM): quick sync — we need to lock pilot scope for the Optimize advisor for CustA. They want batching + cache recs, quantization guidance, and eval-triggered alerts. timeline: demo to their infra team in 3 weeks.
Ben (Eng): can we pare down for the pilot? full eval-alerting looks large.
Carla (MLEng): agree, alerting requires eval infra + stable eval sets. We can ship simple regression alerts first (monitored prompts + perf delta).
Sasha (CS): CustA is insisting on two things: cost guidance per-1000 tokens and an auto-notify when quality drops >5% on their key prompt set.
Diego (Solutions): for the demo we can show batching + KV-cache recommendations and a rough quantization checklist. Alerts can be mocked UI-wise if infra isn't ready.
Sam (PM): proposed MVP split: MUST: batching rules + cache hit estimation + per-workload econ calc. SHOULD: quantization recs (per model family) + simple eval delta alerts (email/Slack). NICE-TO-HAVE: automated rollout policy tied to alerts. Opinions?
Ben (Eng): technical constraints: batching suggestions require request distribution histograms. Do we expect customers to upload telemetry or do we sample from API gateway?
Sasha (CS): CustA won't give gateway access. they'll upload a daily sample file (JSONL) of requests.
Carla (MLEng): OK — we can run offline analysis on JSONL to compute seq len dist, prefix reuse, and suggested batch sizes. Alert evals will need labeled reference outputs for the key prompts.
Diego (Solutions): for demo we can accept a minimal JSONL with fields: input_id, prompt, model, latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out. here's a sample:
```
{"input_id":"1","prompt":"Summarize...","model":"gptx-4f","latency_ms":120,"tokens_in":80,"tokens_out":60}
```
Sam (PM): good. launch criteria proposal: 1) batching + cache rec engine runs on uploaded sample + produces a one-page recommendation; 2) econ calc (estimated $/1k tokens) for 3 model/quant options; 3) regression alert prototype that flags >5% drop on digest prompts and can send to Slack/email; 4) docs + runbook for customers to run locally.
Ben (Eng): timeline feasibility: 3 weeks is tight but doable if we scope alerting to a nightly job that compares current eval metrics to baseline and emits a single alert webhook. No streaming.
Carla (MLEng): will need curated baseline eval set from CustA. Sasha can you confirm they can supply ~200 golden prompts?
Sasha (CS): will ask. they said yes to a small set, but need to confirm 200. I'll follow up today.
Diego (Solutions): UX for recommendations — suggest a short report with: suggested batch size, expected latency impact, expected cost delta, cacheable prefix % and suggested cache TTL.
Sam (PM): agree. also include risk flags: "not safe to quantize" for models with unstable outputs on eval set.
Ben (Eng): implementation note: quant recs will be heuristics + prior internal benchmarks. we'll add an opt-in toggle for "aggressive quant" in report.
Carla (MLEng): alert rule prototype: compare metric 'exact_match' or 'semantic_score' on key prompts. if drop >=5% over baseline AND p-value <0.05 (bootstrap) -> trigger. simple config yaml: 
```
rule_name: custA_regression
metric: semantic_score
baseline_window: 14d
compare_window: 1d
threshold_pct: 5
alert_targets: ["#custA-ops", "custA@company.com"]
```
Ben (Eng): that statistical test might be heavy; for pilot we can do simple moving averages + thresholding, mark it as experimental.
Sam (PM): decision: go with moving average threshold for pilot, but show the planned bootstrap upgrade in docs.
Sasha (CS): customer timeline update — they can provide sample and 100 golden prompts by next Tue. good enough to demo?
Carla (MLEng): yes for demo. will warn them about sample size limits.
Diego (Solutions): I'll prepare a demo script that walks through uploading JSONL, generating recommendations, and firing a simulated alert.
release-bot: created ticket #OPT-6123: "Pilot: batching/cache/quant recommendations + eval-alert prototype for CustA"
Sam (PM): next steps: Ben/Carla implement offline pipeline + report, Diego builds demo flow, Sasha confirms assets. weekly check-in Thurs. any blockers?
Ben (Eng): need access to internal bench results for quant heuristics — @Carla can you point to the dataset?
Carla (MLEng): posted link to internal drive in #eng-ml.
Sasha (CS): I'll ping CustA for the 100 prompts now.
Sam (PM): thanks all. I'll update the pilot PRD with these launch gates and share after this thread. :thumbsup:
